description:
This English current synthesis defines QIK-VRT observer-relative retrocausality as a negative information direction: a receiver's strictly increasing local change time is paired with decreasing provenance-bound source marks for successive information-bearing records.

For spacelike-separated comparisons, a coordinate-future assignment is not a causal-future relation. A source-bound record remains unavailable until a future-directed delivery path reaches the receiver.

The record includes the 8-page English working paper, exact TeX and archive source, deterministic local render and compatibility receipts, a finite network-free executable witness and its canonical report, and claim/evidence/boundary proof artifacts. The witness checks a declared finite operational model; it is not a Lean kernel receipt, an independent empirical confirmation, or a measurement of nature as a whole.

The work does not claim backward-running metric proper time, receipt before emission, past overwrite, causal loops, superluminal or past-directed propagation, a controllable message into the causal past, independent empirical confirmation, or scientific consensus. Ingolf Lohmann's QIK-VRT correspondence thesis is explicitly attributed and kept distinct from those boundaries.

This new record is derived from, but does not alter, the historical Zenodo record 21888130.

title: Observer-Relative Retrocausality: Negative Information Direction Along Monotonic Local Change Time
